name: sharepoint-site-assessment
description: Read-only assessment of classic and modern SharePoint sites: analyzes exported inventories and schemas offline (per-page migration complexity scoring, web-part behavior grouping, site navigation depth, custom-form classification, permissions and broken inheritance, schema export comparison, choice columns, calculated columns) and collects them live with read-only PnP.PowerShell/on-prem collectors for lists, libraries, content types and pages. Analysis rules and behavioral knowledge are caller-supplied, never built in; no workflow writes to a tenant.
